# FOLO
> FOLO Only Looks Once: a from-scratch Rust vision framework (tensors, autograd, CPU + wgpu GPU kernels, a YOLO-style
> detector, training/eval/export), a CLI (`folo`, every command supports --json), an HTTP API and the FOLO Studio web app.

- [Agent rules](AGENTS.md)
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
- [Detector spec: model, loss, training recipe](docs/MODEL.md)
- [HTTP API](docs/API.md)
- [MCP server for agents](docs/MCP.md): `folo mcp [--data-dir D] [--mock] [--read-only] [--confine] [--server URL]`,
  stdio, MCP 2026-07-28 and 2025-11-25. 16 tools (folo_info, list_datasets, get_dataset, list_dataset_images,
  register_dataset, create_synthetic_dataset, list_models, train, run_status, list_runs, stop_run, val, predict,
  predict_batch, export, compare_runs) with JSON Schemas, `folo://` resources (dataset images as blobs, subscribable
  runs and metrics, sample grids, docs), prompts train_on_folder and diagnose_run. Tool failures are `isError`
  results whose text is `{code, message, hint}`. `--mock` runs the whole flow without the engine. Setup for
  Claude Code / Codex: README.md, "Use FOLO from Claude Code / Codex"
- [CLI conventions, `folo describe --json`](docs/CLI.md) (its `mcp_tools` lists every MCP tool with its schemas)
- [Roadmap](docs/ROADMAP.md)
